The Refuge is prosperous because people learned how to survive Sablewood, not because Sablewood became safe. The Refuge feels warm but not static: soup, blankets, repairs, whispers, small injuries, and people deciding whether rest is enough. Block4: The place changes even if the PCs stand still. Local people, creatures, weather, signage, and ward behavior all keep moving around the scene. Prosperity can hide who paid for it. Travelers may normalize danger to protect pride. Bad route news changes mood fast. A trophy cracks when nobody touches it. A route board flips from open to delayed. Let the place be funny through overconfident signage, awkward forms, stubborn local habits, and magic that refuses corporate language.
